alignments.note: Inflected verb takes subject *I* and the supplied object *thee* as rule 7/9 helpers; head on the lexical verb *charge*.

Improper preposition with a complex frame. Rule 95 classes ἐνώπιον improper despite its PREP tag, and rule 71 heads the frame on its lexical noun *sight*. The ASV gives the governed noun no determiner, so under rule 101 the trailing *of* stays with the adverb (the REV.14.10 shape) and the article anchors nothing.
No English determiner for *God*; rule 23. The *of* rides with ἐνώπιον's frame rather than with this article, since rule 21 forbids a bare *of* on a determinerless article.
Noun to noun.
Coordinating conjunction.
Repeated case preposition *of* rides with the noun (rule 21, determinerless); head on the name. Split from Ἰησοῦ under rule 28.
Separately recoverable name, split from Χριστοῦ under rules 17 and 28.
Substantival article before a participle rendered by the single word *who*; rule 90 gives that word to the article as pronoun-and-relativizer at once, the participle keeping its own verb.
μέλλω + infinitive is rendered as the English future; the auxiliary *shall* is what answers to the participle.
Complementary infinitive to the lexical verb.
Anarthrous substantival participle; rule 51's anarthrous clause makes the supplied *the* an ordinary rule 7 helper on the word it determines, headed on *living*.
Coordinating conjunction.
Anarthrous substantival adjective takes its own supplied determiner; rule 58's νεκρῶν → *the dead*.
Coordinating conjunction.
αὐτοῦ occupies the English determiner slot with *his*, so the article realizes nothing (rule 20).
Discontinuous under rule 15. The case preposition *by* stays with the noun because the article carries no determiner to anchor it (rule 21, determinerless clause).
Genitive pronoun rendered by the possessive.
Coordinating conjunction.
Displaced by the possessive *his* on αὐτοῦ; rule 20.
Noun to noun.
Genitive pronoun rendered by the possessive.

review_notes: ἐνώπιον is treated as an improper preposition under rule 95 (lexeme, not morph tag), so the frame *in the sight of* is one unit headed on *sight* per rule 71, with rule 101 keeping the trailing *of* on it because the ASV supplies no determiner for *God*.
The accusative-of-adjuration τὴν ἐπιφάνειαν αὐτοῦ takes *by* on the noun rather than on the article, since αὐτοῦ has already emptied the article under rule 20.
